groups.title: The run and its clock
groups.title_it: La run e il suo orologio

analytics_snapshots.note: Hourly totals (active users, photos, reactions, comments, follows) written at the end of each round.

columns.name: total_photos
columns.desc: Photos in the run so far.

comments.note: Comments and replies to photos, with sentiment, likes and soft-delete flags.

direct_messages.note: Private messages between two accounts, optionally attaching a photo.

emotions.note: Catalogue of the emotions that can be attached to reactions and photos.

follow.note: Every follow and unfollow as an event: one row per pair, with the action and the round of the last change.

columns.name: action
columns.desc: follow or unfollow (the last action of the pair).

follow_requests.note: Requests to follow a private account, with their status.

memory_interaction_events.note: Interactions recorded for the agent memory (only with memory on).

memory_social_cards.note: Social cards of the agent memory: affinity, conflict, humour and trust towards another account (only with memory on).

mentions.note: Accounts mentioned in a photo caption or comment.

moderation_events.note: Decisions of the moderation stub: the action taken, reason and confidence.

opinion_paths.note: Every change of opinion: from, to, direction, the post that caused it and the model.

columns.name: model_name
columns.desc: Opinion model that wrote the row.

rules: unique uq_opinion_path_transition: (user_id, topic, round_id, source_score, target_score, transition)

photo_emotions.note: Dominant visual emotion of a photo (annotation), with score and viral score.

photo_hashtags.note: Links a photo to its hashtags.

photo_topics.note: Topics assigned to a photo, with the confidence of the assignment.

photos.note: Every published photo: author, caption, image, filter, location, counters, scores and the rounds of creation and removal.

columns.name: deleted_at
columns.desc: When it was soft-deleted; empty while live.

post_emotions.note: Emotions attached to a post by the annotators.

post_sentiment.note: Sentiment (negative, positive, neutral, compound) of posts, comments and reactions.

post_toxicity.note: Perspective API scores of a post or comment.

reactions.note: The reaction of an account to a photo (like or an emotion), one row each.

recommendations.note: The list of photos the recommender offered to an account in a round.

reported.note: Reports filed by accounts against a photo or comment, with the reason.

rounds.note: The time axis: one row per round (one simulated hour), with day and hour; every `round` column points here.

stories.note: Stories (24 hours): media, sticker, caption, view counter and expiry.

story_views.note: Who watched which story, and when.

stress_reward.note: Variations of stress and reward of each account, with the event that caused them and the round.
rules: check ck_stress_reward_value: (type = 'aggregate' AND value >= 0 AND value <= 1) OR (type = 'variation' AND value >= -1 AND value <= 1)

trending_hashtags.note: Ranking of hashtags per round, with the number of photos that used them.

columns.name: photo_count
columns.desc: Photos that used it in the window.

user_interest.note: Interests of an account, with the round in which they were recorded.

user_mgmt.note: One row per account (agent, page or human): persona, Big Five, archetype, activity profile, profile data, influence and satisfaction scores, churn flag.

columns.name: user_type
columns.desc: Kind of model that drives the agent.

columns.name: left_on
columns.desc: Round of departure; empty while active.

columns.name: daily_activity_level
columns.desc: Level 1-5 that scales the hourly probability of acting.

columns.name: last_active_day
columns.desc: Last day with an action (used for inactivity churn).

columns.name: is_shadow_banned
columns.desc: 1 when the moderation reduced the reach of the account.

user_opinions.note: Opinion of an account on a topic in a round (score and label), per model.

columns.name: model_name
columns.desc: Opinion model that wrote the row.
